name: m5-scaling-heap-rejuv
description: `m5-scaling-heap` with `chunked-weak-rejuv` added: 1.5 GB of heap per concurrent compile, 4 MB regions, Graal 25.4.4, M5 Pro. At this heap share the young generation is small, chunks are promoted and dirty cards, and `chunked-weak`'s lead over `chained-weak` stayed at 5–17% for every N. Hypothesis: copying recently written element chunks after each GC keeps them young and restores the gap, increasingly so as N grows.
